narrative.northStar: Dark, precise, the note is the sheet
narrative.overview: Nexus is a notebook worked in for hours: dark first (navy #02070A frame, the work on one inset sheet a tone step up), crisp hairlines, flat surfaces, Hanken Grotesk display type set large and tight, Literata for notes, JetBrains Mono for code only. One selection mark everywhere: a 1px blue line as wide as the selected label. Blue #0297DE for links, the active item, focus and the primary action; orange #FC734D for tags, highlights and search hits. Light follows the same structure on a blue-grey frame. See DESIGN.md for tokens and components.
keyCharacteristics: An L-shaped tinted frame around an inset white sheet with 14px corners.
Two colour meanings and nothing else: blue moves, orange marks.
Serif for the person's writing, grotesque for the interface, mono for code.
Flat at rest; a shadow appears only on things that float (menus, dialogs, toasts).
Light and dark follow the system; dark is navy, never grey-black.

rules.name: The Two Meanings Rule
rules.body: Blue moves you (links, active item, focus, primary action). Orange marks things (#tags, ==highlights==, search hits). Neither colour is ever used for decoration, and they never swap jobs.

rules.name: The Checked Pair Rule
rules.body: Every text/ground pair is ≥ 4.5:1 and every control edge and focus ring is ≥ 3:1, in both themes. New tokens are added to `src/app/globals.css` with their ratio, never as raw hex in a component.

rules.name: The Writing Wears Serif Rule
rules.body: Only text the person wrote is set in Literata. Anything the product says is Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing that sits in the layout casts a shadow. Only things that float above it do.

dos: Do use blue only for movement (links, active item, focus, primary action) and orange only for marks (tags, highlights, search hits).
Do add every new colour as a token in `src/app/globals.css`, for both themes, with its contrast ratio checked (≥ 4.5:1 text, ≥ 3:1 edges and rings).
Do keep the note on the sheet: Literata at 17px on a 700px measure, with the inline title as the h1.
Do follow Obsidian's conventions (ribbon, explorer, tabs, backlinks, command palette, hotkeys) when a choice is open; users arrive with Obsidian habits.
Do use motion only as feedback (view transitions on note change, 150–200ms quint ease) and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do write interface copy in English, sentence case, naming the action ("Create vault", "Replace notes").
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, glass or coloured nav pills, or put icons in tinted tiles.
Don't add shadows to anything that sits in the layout; only floating surfaces get the Float shadow.
Don't use tracked-out capital labels or a monospace face for non-code labels.
Don't put coloured side borders thicker than 1px on callouts, cards or rows.
Don't use emoji in interface copy, or bring back the old purple accent.
Don't set small text in Link Blue (#0297de) on white; use Link Blue Ink.
